# Image Wheel Zoom & Pan

A DSH Web client plugin that adds direct wheel zoom and left-drag panning to
images opened in the ri

ient plugin that adds direct wheel zoom and left-drag panning to
images opened in the right sidebar.

The built-in image preview supports the zoom buttons and `Ctrl`+wheel; this
plugin registers an `ext
ension`-band image renderer so the same files open with:
| Gesture | Result |

| Mouse wheel over the image | Zoom around the pointer, 1%–800% |
| Hold left mouse button and drag

| Pan the image; the cursor becomes a grab hand |
| Double-click | Fit the image to the pane |
| Bot
tom toolbar | `−` / percentage / `+` / **Fit** / **100%** |
PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO and SVG are handled. SVG stays in the browser's static `` mode;
its scripts never execute.

published on npm as
`dsh-image-wheel-pan` and
can also be installed straight from GitHub.

## Use

Open an image in the right sidebar. New image tabs select this renderer
automatically. A tab that al

ready used the built-in image viewer can switch from
the dropdown in the preview header to **Image W

lt-in image viewer can switch from
the dropdown in the preview header to **Image Wheel Zoom & Pan**.

- Scroll over the image to zoom; no Ctrl is required.
- Hold the left mouse button and drag to pan.

- Double-click, or press **Fit**, to fit the whole image to the pane.
- **100%** shows the image at
its intrinsic CSS-pixel size.
## Notes

- Pan/zoom is transient per mounted preview; closing or reloading the tab resets
it to fit.
- The vi

ewer owns the image surface: wheel events over it do not scroll the
right pane.
- The renderer only

reads the image bytes the preview already loaded; it makes
no additional file or network request.

## 中文说明
在右侧文件预览里打开 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/ICO/SVG 后：

- 直接滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放（不需要按 Ctrl），以鼠标位置为中心；
- 按住鼠标左键拖动即可平移，光标会变成抓取手形；
- 双击图片或点底部的 **Fit** 恢复适应窗口；**100%** 恢复

标滚轮即可缩放（不需要按 Ctrl），以鼠标位置为中心；
- 按住鼠标左键拖动即可平移，光标会变成抓取手形；
- 双击图片或点底部的 **Fit** 恢复适应窗口；**100%** 恢复原始像素比例。

安装：在 DSH 的 **Plugins → Add plugin** 里粘贴仓库地址
`https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-image-wheel-pan` 安装；安装后

如果页面已经打开，刷新一次。
新开的图片标签会自动使用这个渲染器；已经打开的图片标签可以在预览顶部下拉框中切换到
**图片滚轮缩放与拖动**。
